title: Enterprise Inbound Optimizer & Scope-Scout for Sales/CS Feature Bundles
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Problem: Sales and Customer Success regularly surface multiple correlated enterprise feature asks from the same account and across account cohorts. Current intake is fragmented (spread across notes, email threads, and one-off doc uploads), leading to duplicate work, inconsistent prioritization, and missed quick wins. Goal: Build a lightweight intake optimizer (Scope-Scout) to aggregate Sales/CS asks, label them with an initial priority and economics heuristic, and produce a concise scoped brief for PM/Eng review within 48 business hours. This ticket is the PM-level orchestration: define the heuristics, UX for CS/Sales-facing intake form, and the first-pass export (scoped brief + ask clusters) for engineering/product kickoff.
acceptance_criteria: A single standardized intake template is published and reachable by Sales/CS with example completions
Automated clustering groups related asks from the same account or cohort with a confidence score
Each cluster produces a 1-page scoped brief (problem, user impact, tentative solution, rough econ estimate) deliverable within 48 business hours
PM and Solutions Eng can review and either approve to schedule deep-scope or request more info within the first review action
Dashboard shows counts of new asks, clusters pending PM review, and estimated monthly ARR impact bucketed by confidence
proposed_solution: 1) Publish a canonical intake form (Google Form + shortcut) and embed in CS playbook. 2) Lightweight backend pipeline (scripted) to normalize fields (use account metadata, product area, keywords). 3) Run a similarity-based clustering pass (title + description + account tags) to create clusters. 4) Apply an economics heuristic -- ARR proxy (account tier * ask complexity multiplier) + likelihood score from CS rep. 5) Generate a 1-page scoped brief template populated from cluster summary and heuristics. 6) Deliver briefs to PM triage queue and surface top-10 cost/impact items on weekly intake dashboard.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Clustering may group unrelated asks if descriptions are sparse -> Mitigation: require minimum fields in intake form and train simple keyword boosts for product areas
Risk: Economics heuristic may over/under estimate ARR impact -> Mitigation: surface heuristics and make values editable by Solutions Eng; track actual conversion over next 3 cycles to recalibrate
Risk: Sales/CS adoption slow -> Mitigation: provide one-pager and short training, pair with rep-level incentives (faster response SLA) and show early triage wins

Risk: Privacy/security of uploaded artifacts -> Mitigation: intake form warns about PII and routes attachments to secure drives; flag security_review_required if customer requests include sensitive data

rollout_plan: Pilot with five CS reps for 3 weeks -> collect feedback and measure: intake completion rate, clustering precision, time-to-brief, and estimated ARR coverage. If pilot metrics meet thresholds (intake completion >75%, clustering precision >65%, avg time-to-brief <48h), expand to all CS and add Sales access. Post-expansion: bake into Console intake dashboard and run monthly recalibration of econ heuristics.
estimate_breakdown: PM: 1.5 pts (templates, process), Eng: 2.5 pts (clustering job + brief generator), UX: 1 pt (form + playbook card)
